status: Recommended vector study; not user selection or production integration

findings: Most object silhouettes readable; exact homing, delay and global targeting need tooltips.
Practice Thrust and Spotlight Lance both read as diagonal gold marks.
Curtain Flash reads as a static curtain or banner.
Mischief Crumb reads as a red button or cookie.
Hearth Glow dome can suggest protection rather than damage.

changes: Spotlight Lance is a horizontal, parallel-sided beam with a square emitter and bright core.
Curtain Flash uses two side panels and a central pale flash.
Mischief Crumb has biscuit-tan fill, dark chips and a bite notch.
Hearth Glow has a visible flame inside the hearth opening.
iterations.verdict: Pass for labelled20/24-pixel UI distinction and family consistency. No further edits requested.
iterations.limits: This is a contextual semantic review, not an independent recognition score. Tooltips remain necessary for homing, delay and global-target behavior.
